TEXT (text_source=study_materials): CATI questionnaire cues3480.pdf prints P.12 as three separate read-aloud questions, one per grid row; item_text ships each item's full read-aloud question verbatim (pdftotext -raw and -layout agree; line breaks joined with a space; each asserted present verbatim in the whitespace-collapsed raw text layer by build.R), since that is what the respondent heard -- the grid row labels (= variable labels) are the interviewer's shorthand and are quoted above. Kept verbatim, not corrected: item 1 opens with the transition 'Cambiando de tema,' and says 'ideologías diferentes' (no 'políticas'); item 2 reads 'compañeros' (grid/label: 'Compañeros/as') and the source's own agreement slip 'ideología políticas' [sic].
